label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler dominates The American Express
items.text: Scottie Scheffler finished The American Express at 27-under, with Jason Day, Ryan Gerard, Matt McCarty, and Andrew Putnam trailing at 23-under.

items.headline: Justin Rose shines at Farmers Insurance Open
items.text: Justin Rose completed the Farmers Insurance Open at 23-under, outpacing Pierceson Coody, Si Woo Kim, and Ryo Hisatsune who finished at 16-under.

items.headline: Austin Smotherman leads Bank of Utah Championship
items.text: Austin Smotherman closed the Bank of Utah Championship at 26-under, ahead of Doug Ghim at 24-under and David Ford and Trace Crowe at 23-under.
